Tooele County, Utah real estate

The Laramie Dunn Team helps people buy and sell homes across the Tooele Valley: Grantsville, Stansbury Park, Tooele, Erda, Lake Point, and Stockton. Lisa Neil and Laramie Dunn are licensed Utah real estate agents with RealtyPath LLC, and between them they have decades in this valley and working relationships with the builders here.

Buyers get a search run in the Utah MLS against exactly what they asked for, new-listing alerts, and a walkthrough of the buyer-broker agreement Utah requires before an agent represents you. Sellers get a straight pricing conversation, prep advice, and a professional video package on every listing.

Use the search above to tell us the area and price range, browse the area guides, or call either agent directly. This site does not display MLS listings; every search is run for you by the team.
